# RASMOO SP-02 synthetic fixtures

These fixtures preserve forms and relations confirmed in the manually supplied
CASE-01 and CASE-02 examples. The CASE-03 transition fixture is a synthetic
exercise derived from the user-confirmed marker mapping, not a captured
transition sample. Titles, archive names, and marker identifiers have been
replaced with synthetic values. Line breaks, observed spacing, within-fragment
ordering, repeated references, and the confirmed cross-reference between an
index entry and its video post are retained.

Fragments are separate where their relative source order was not established.
The video-post path is kept in its observed form (unmarked first title, then
`=` and `==`); the index path uses `=`, `==`, and `===`. Both normalize to the
same Track → Course → Module → Lesson domain as confirmed by the user.

`manifest.json` records the synthetic media attached to each text fixture and
labels the transition exercise as synthetic rather than user-supplied evidence.
It contains no Telegram identifiers or downloaded media.

These are evidence/contract fixtures, not parser tests. They encode the
confirmed composite identity and conservative reconciliation decisions; they
do not model edits/reordering or ambiguous collisions beyond preserving them as
unresolved requirements.
